notes.title: Episode 1 released now!
notes.content:
Hi all!
Brutalsoft on the line.
Our development plan changed, cuz we havent enough finances to make more content ( like backgrounds, comix arts, enemies etc ). So we decide to release Invasion: Episode 1 and make more episodes if it will be enough money to do it.
I hope all people who like Invasion, will buy it to support development.

Also, fans can support us on the Patreon:
https://www.patreon.com/brutalsoft

Thank you for attention!
I wish you sweet dreams and hot fights.
Be cool guys.

notes.title: Changes of difficulty.
notes.content:
Hi all! Brutalsoft on the line!

Unfortunately, i was busy last month and almost not working on the project. But now i see clear that high skill levels are overhelmed. Gaming on the Hero and Insane difficulties is not fun, but like heavy dirty work. So i decided to reduce complexity for Veteran, Hero, and Insane skills. I hope you will like it.

Be happy and kill em all!

notes.title: Controls, buy menu and some little bugs.
notes.content:
Hi all!
According to many questions about subject items, we writing this post.

[b]1. Controls.[/b]
Some people don't understand how to control furious game world. This is simple - just see main menu item [b]HELP[/b]. You can see into control buttons, bonuses and info panel description.

[b]2. Buy menu.[/b]
Some people says what buy menu is not friendly and hard to understand. So we decided to make new buy menu with more obvious graphical interface. For now, you can see attentively buy episode in the game trailer.

[b]3. Some little bugs.[/b]
We have some little bug reports like repeatedly opening achievements. Don't worry, we working on errors and updating game build in shortest time.
